description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) to ISO, UTC and Riyadh time, or a date-time to a Unix timestamp. Omit input for the current time. Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/timestamp-converter

timezone.description: IANA time zone for local time, default Asia/Riyadh.

value.description: Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, or a date-time such as 2026-11-03T10:00:00Z. Empty for now.
